description: Source code for the NativeZilkerClient class, which manages starting, stopping, and configuring a Zilker client process, including IPC handling, configuration setup, and process management.

classes.name: NativeZilkerClient
classes.description: Main class managing the lifecycle and configuration of a Zilker client process, including process startup, shutdown, IPC communication, and configuration setup.

methods.name: NativeZilkerClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client, optionally with a configuration directory, and generating a unique CPE ID.

methods.name: getCpeId
methods.description: Returns the generated CPE ID.

methods.name: getDefaultGenericProps
methods.description: Provides default generic properties for client configuration.

methods.name: setGenericPropConfig
methods.description: Sets a specific generic property key-value pair.

methods.name: setClientConfigCustomizer
methods.description: Sets a customizer for client configuration.

methods.name: setIncludePackagedWhitelist
methods.description: Configures whether to include packaged whitelist.

methods.name: setStartActivated
methods.description: Configures whether to start the client in an activated state.

methods.name: isDebug
methods.description: Checks if debug mode is enabled via system property.

methods.name: resetConfig
methods.description: Resets and prepares the configuration directory.

methods.name: copyResourceToDir
methods.description: Copies a resource file from classpath to a destination directory.

methods.name: populateConfig
methods.description: Populates configuration files and directories for the client.

methods.name: createConfigDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary configuration directory.

methods.name: setupConfig
methods.description: Sets up configuration directory and files, including cleanup hook.

methods.name: determineZilkerTop
methods.description: Determines the top directory of the Zilker SDK based on environment or relative path.

methods.name: isConflictingClientRunning
methods.description: Checks if another Zilker client process is already running by attempting to bind to a known IPC port.

methods.name: isProcessStarted
methods.description: Checks if the client process has been started.

methods.name: findZilkerBinary
methods.description: Locates the Zilker executable binary based on environment or default paths.

methods.name: startProcess
methods.description: Starts the Zilker process with appropriate environment variables and configuration.

methods.name: getProcessInputStream
methods.description: Returns the input stream of the process.

methods.name: getProcessErrorStream
methods.description: Returns the error stream of the process.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Main method to start the client process, setting up configuration if needed.

methods.name: createIOPump
methods.description: Creates a thread to pump data from an input stream to an output stream.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the client process by stopping and then starting it again.

methods.name: getGDBPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the GDB debugger.

methods.name: doBacktrace
methods.description: Attempts to generate a backtrace of the client process using GDB.

methods.name: waitForProcessExit
methods.description: Waits for the process to exit within a timeout.

methods.name: killProcess
methods.description: Terminates the process forcibly.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the client process, performing a clean shutdown if configured.

methods.name: isSingleProcess
methods.description: Returns whether the client is running in single process mode.

methods.name: setSingleProcess
methods.description: Sets whether the client should run in single process mode.

methods.name: getZilkerTop
methods.description: Returns the top directory of the Zilker SDK.

methods.name: getConfigDir
methods.description: Returns the current configuration directory.

methods.name: setConfigDir
methods.description: Sets the configuration directory.

methods.name: isCleanShutdown
methods.description: Returns whether the client is configured for clean shutdown.

methods.name: setCleanShutdown
methods.description: Sets whether the client should perform a clean shutdown.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method for command-line invocation, initializing configuration.
